input.request: Build Tab Split, a shared-expense settlement page. Token name: Tab Split. Token symbol: TAB. The fixed total supply is 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1,000,000,000 * 10^18 base units), minted once to the deployer. SharedTab lets an organizer open a bill with a bytes32 label and deadline, add named participants with fixed uint256 shares, and lets each participant pay only their own share; the organizer withdraws only after every share is paid, or participants reclaim after expiry. Deploy on Sepolia and publish a page to open, join, pay and settle tabs.
input.context: Sepolia only (chainId 11155111); GitHub and IPFS are approved. Include Foundry tests and an independent adversarial review. Constructors use only address, uint256, bool or bytes32 arguments; the launch token constructor is zero-argument. foundry.toml must set bytecode_hash = "none". No proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Organizers and participants invoke their own economically useful actions; no offchain keeper is assumed.

draft.objective: Build and review TAB and SharedTab, deploy them on Sepolia, then publish the live shared-expense website.

steps.objective: Implement fixed-supply TAB and the per-participant tab accounting.
Test share totals, duplicate payment refusal, settlement, refunds, and expiry.
Independently adversarially review the token and SharedTab.
Build the live shared-tab page with connected-wallet payment flows.
